title: Long 16km with fast finish
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 16km. First 13km at 145-155bpm, last 3km lifted to 160-166bpm. Do not start the lift early.
GYM: none.
FUEL: test Tailwind here. One 500ml flask, 2 scoops, sipped from 30min. First run on the new mix.
STOP RULE: abandon the fast finish if cadence drops below 170.
WHY: durability plus the first controlled rehearsal of finishing hard on tired legs, which is exactly what VWT's last 5km demands.
